title: Operation: Shadow Network
description: Infiltrate a rogue server used by the shadow network.
storyline: Intel suggests a rogue faction has set up a vulnerable ping service. We need you to gain access, retrieve their secret intel, and find out who is pulling the strings.

missions.title: Reconnaissance
missions.objective: Identify the vulnerability in the web application.
missions.storyline_text: The target is hosting a simple web tool. See what it does.
instructions: Observe the input field that takes an IP address.
Test it with a normal IP like 8.8.8.8 to see the behavior.

hints.hint_text: It looks like it is running a system ping command.
What happens if you add a semicolon (;) after the IP?

questions.question_text: What type of vulnerability is present when user input is directly passed to a system shell?

missions.title: Exploitation
missions.objective: Exploit the command injection to read sensitive files.
missions.storyline_text: Now that you know it's vulnerable, we need the hidden flag on the server.
instructions: Inject a command to list the directory contents (e.g., ; ls).
Read the contents of the flag file (e.g., ; cat flag.txt).

flags.flag_description: The secret flag stored on the server.
